# apple_game_center_activity_default_image (Resource)

Uploads the default image of a Game Center activity, shown for locales without an image of their own. An activity has one default image; uploading another replaces it. The image goes to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying a changed file starts the next one, and a change fails while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the image from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with the activity's ID; the next apply then uploads the configured file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_activity_default_image" "example" {
  activity_id = apple_game_center_activity.example.id
  file        = "${path.module}/activity.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activity_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the activity, e.g. `apple_game_center_activity.example.id`.
- `file` (String) Path of the image. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the uploaded file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the image, which changes with each version and upload.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_activity_default_image.example
  identity = {
    activity_id = "1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `activity_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the activity, e.g. `apple_game_center_activity.example.id`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_activity_default_image.example 1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a
```
